title: Your 2027, Month by Month

plan.title: April and May: things heat up
Your elements in a fire year
December and January: closing the year

intake.question: What do you want 2027 to be about?

love.speaker: bom
love.text: Love and people for 2027. Good. This year has a lot to say about who you let close.

work.speaker: yeon
work.text: Work and building something. So you've already got a vision board. With a Gantt chart behind it.

self.speaker: bom
self.text: Yourself: habits, calm, growth. The quiet goal. Usually the one that changes everything else.

fresh.speaker: yeon
fresh.text: A fresh start. Bold. Let's make sure it's a fresh start and not the same start in a new outfit.

unsaid.speaker: yeon
unsaid.text: You didn't pick a focus for 2027. Classic. The year will pick for you if you don't.

great.speaker: bom
great.text: 2026 felt great. Love that. 2027 is about keeping the good and not getting comfortable.

heavy.speaker: bom
heavy.text: 2026 was heavy. You got through it. That counts for more than you think.

messy.speaker: yeon
messy.text: Messy 2026. Like a group chat with no admin and nine side plots.

quiet.speaker: yeon
quiet.text: 2026 was quiet. Not much happened. You've been on airplane mode. 2027 turns the signal back on.

unsaid.speaker: bom
unsaid.text: No word on 2026. That's okay. Some years don't fit in one word.

strong.text:
Yeon: Strong chart. You'll want to use the whole year at full speed. You'll be exhausted by September.

Bom: You have real energy for this one.

Yeon: So pace it. Two big pushes, two real rests, the rest ordinary.

Pick your two push months now. Put them in your calendar before January does it for you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Two sprints, two rests. Not twelve sprints and a collapse.

weak.text:
Bom: Your chart runs soft. A fire year can feel like a lot: busy, loud, everyone wanting something.

Yeon: Which means saying no is your 2027 skill. Practise it in January.

Bom: The year can lift you if you pick a few things and let the rest pass by.

Choose three things for the year. Write them down. Anything not on the list gets a polite "not this year".

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Three things for 2027. Everything else can wait.

gap-wood.text:
At work, you're the one who finally says the meeting is pointless. With friends, you're funnier and sharper than usual. In love, you want to be admired for what you make.

Yeon: Test every idea with one question: can you show something real in six weeks? If yes, chase it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Six weeks to something real. That's your 2027 filter.

gap-wood.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

eul-wood.text:
You host more. You make more. You finally sign up for the class. Small side opportunities show up through people you already know.

Yeon: Say yes to the fun ones. Say no to the "can you just" ones.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Yes to joy. No to "can you just".

eul-wood.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

byeong-fire.text:
Someone with your energy turns up: a rival, a collaborator, a friend who wants the same spotlight. Your ideas get bolder and your filter gets thinner.

Yeon: Share the stage once. It'll make you look bigger, not smaller.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Two suns in one sky this year. Share the stage.

byeong-fire.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

jeong-fire.text:
Your people multiply: friends of friends, a new team, a crowd that feels like yours. You also want to make something just because you enjoy it.

Bom: Let one creative thing be purely for fun. No audience required.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Make one thing just because you love it.

jeong-fire.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

mu-earth.text:
People who want to teach you, back you or open a door turn up. At the same time, someone close competes for the same thing you want.

Yeon: Take the help. Ignore the scoreboard.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Accept the help this year. You've earned it.

mu-earth.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

gi-earth.text:
You learn something unexpected: a course, a weird hobby, a teacher who appears out of nowhere. Your friend circle tightens and gets louder.

Yeon: Guard your energy. Not everyone at your table should be at your table.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: New year, smaller table, better people.

gi-earth.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

gyeong-metal.text:
Responsibility knocks: a promotion, a title, a role where people look to you. Good support arrives at the same time, if you let it.

Bom: Lead without carrying it alone. That's the 2027 upgrade.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Step up, and let people help you up.

gyeong-metal.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

sin-metal.text:
The pressure's real: deadlines, expectations, one person who tests you. So is the backup. You learn faster this year than you have in ages.

Yeon: Don't polish everything. Polish the thing that counts.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pressure year. Choose which jewel to polish.

sin-metal.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

im-water.text:
Something pulls you in and binds you: a person, a partnership, a project worth committing to. Structure shows up too, and you might actually like it.

Bom: Commitment can feel like freedom when it's the right thing.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Something worth committing to is coming. Notice it.

im-water.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

gye-water.text:
New people, new invitations, a fuller calendar than you're used to. Plus a challenge that asks you to be braver than you'd choose to be.

Yeon: RSVP yes. You can always slip out after an hour.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Show up. One hour still counts.

gye-water.heading: What 2027 looks like on a normal Tuesday

rat.text: Rat and Goat are what saju calls a harm pair: small crossed wires with the people closest to you. Nothing dramatic. Over-explain this year. "I meant this" saves a week of tension.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rat meets Goat: crossed wires. Say what you mean twice.

ox.text: Ox and Goat are opposites, a clash. Expect movement at home: a move, a change, a shift in someone close. Keep one routine steady and the rest can wobble.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Clash year at home. One steady routine keeps you grounded.

tiger.text: Tiger and Goat sit neutral. The year won't shake your inner circle on its own. What you build there is up to you, which is honestly the best deal.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Neutral year at home. Whatever happens, you did it.

rabbit.text: Rabbit and Goat join the Wood trio. A warm link for your personal life: easier connection, friends who feel like family, people on your side.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rabbit and Goat: warm year for your people.

dragon.text: Dragon and Goat sit side by side, two Earth branches. Steady ground at home. Great year for practical home projects. The shelf finally goes up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Steady home year. Build the shelf. Finally.

snake.text: Snake and Goat sit neutral and both run warm. A lively personal life: dinners, plans, plenty of people. Book one quiet weekend a month.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Warm, busy year. Book quiet weekends on purpose.

horse.text: Horse and Goat form a six-harmony pair, one of the sweetest links a year can make with your inner circle. Closeness, ease, support from the people near you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Horse and Goat: one of the sweetest links there is.

goat.text: Goat meets Goat. The year mirrors you, strengths and habits alike. You'll see your own patterns very clearly. Keep the good ones. Name the others.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Mirror year. You'll meet yourself. Be nice to them.

monkey.text: Monkey and Goat sit neutral, and the year's Earth quietly feeds your branch's Metal. Personal plans get gentle support without much drama.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Quiet support at home. Use it for your own plans.

rooster.text: Rooster and Goat sit neutral, with Earth feeding your branch's Metal. A calm year at home. Good time to fix things you've been putting off.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Calm home year. Fix the thing you've been ignoring.

dog.text: Dog and Goat are part of the classic Earth punishment group. Some friction with close people over who does what. Clear agreements save the year.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Friction year at home. Write down who does the dishes.

pig.text: Pig and Goat join the Wood trio. Generous friends, easy cooperation, a warm personal life. Say yes to the people who keep showing up.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Pig and Goat: generous year. Lean on your people.

day_branch_heading: The Goat year meets your inner circle: the {day_animal} ({day_branch})

base.the-year:
The year's fire is the energy your Wood produces: talent, expression, saying what you think. Saju calls it the Hurting Officer, which sounds dramatic because it is.

Yeon: You'll push back on things. Some of them deserve it.

Bom: Underneath, the Goat brings steady, practical goals. Real results you can hold.

Yeon: So: sharp mouth, useful hands. Say the true thing once, kindly. Then build the better version.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the tall pine, it means your voice gets louder.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Louder than now? Brace, everyone.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: This year pairs a restless voice with practical goals. Say it, then build it.

spring.intro: Spring birthday. That's tree season, so you got a double shot of yourself: taller, louder, surer. In saju terms, Wood ran the month you were born in. In real life, you've never once waited to be picked.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood. So the stubbornness is seasonal AND personal. Great.

summer.intro: You're a tree born in the heat. All that growing goes straight into showing: big plans, big talk, big gestures. Summer burns through a pine fast, so you look unstoppable right up until you suddenly need three days in bed.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You give off so much light. Just save a little for yourself.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when soil runs the show. For a tree, that means work: you're always building, fixing, providing. Very useful. Very tired. Somebody should ask what you want for once.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rest is not a prize you win. It's allowed.

autumn.intro: Autumn is axe season, and you're the tree. Life started trimming you early: rules, pressure, people with opinions. It made you sharper and more disciplined than other pines. It also made you allergic to being told what to do.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pruned young. Explains the posture. And the attitude.

winter.intro: A winter pine. The cold kept you quiet on the outside while the roots drank everything. You think longer than you let on, and when you finally move, it's because you already decided weeks ago.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You look calm. Underneath, you've been planning since November.

open.title: 2027: the year you stop asking permission.
open.text:
2027 is the Year of the Fire Goat. For you, the pine, it lights up your voice. Opinions you've been sitting on come out. Rules that make no sense get rewritten.

Bom: You'll feel braver.

Yeon: You'll feel braver and say "actually" in meetings forty percent more.
open.end: Yeon: What the year actually asks of you is more specific than "be brave". Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Pine. The year wakes up and so do you. The | first thing you'll want to change isn't at work. It's closer.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: one thing you say out loud, one thing you build. Not ten. Two.

base.the-year:
Fire you produce, same polarity, the easiest kind. Life wants you to enjoy it, not just keep it running.

Bom: The Goat underneath brings side opportunities. Gigs, offers, doors through people you know.

Yeon: Which means "can you just" requests will triple. You love being asked. Careful.

Bom: Let 2027 be the year your talents get an audience. Even a small one.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the climbing flower, it's a blooming year.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: A blooming year. So you'll finally post the art you've been hiding in your camera roll.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: More joy, more making, more sharing what you love.

spring.intro: Spring birthday for the vine. Everything around you was growing, so you learned to grow toward whatever held still long enough. Charming. Flexible. Absolutely capable of getting your way while people believe they chose it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Double Wood vine. You don't push. You wrap. Same result.

summer.intro: A flower in full sun. You bloom in public: the outfit, the story, the laugh across the room. The cost is that you wilt on the inside when nobody's watering you, and you'd rather die than ask.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're so easy to love. You just don't always let anyone try.

earth.intro: Born in the weeks between seasons, when the soil takes over. For a vine, that means you grow by managing things: schedules, people, plans. You're the reason the group trip happened. Nobody thanked you properly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unpaid project manager of every friendship. Since birth.

autumn.intro: Autumn is cutting season, and you're the soft stem. You grew up reading rooms for danger, learning who's sharp and how to bend before they swing. That's why you're so good with people. It's also why you apologise to furniture.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You flinch at "can we talk" like it's a fire alarm.

winter.intro: A winter flower. Cold outside, so you grew inward: rich head, private feelings, a whole inner world nobody gets the password to. When you trust someone, it's total. Getting there takes a season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your inside is so much warmer than you let people see.

open.title: 2027: the year you enjoy your life instead of managing it.
open.text:
The Fire Goat year is gentle on you. Its fire is the softest kind of output in saju, the Eating God: enjoyment, creativity, sharing what you're good at.

Bom: You'll want to host, make, teach.

Yeon: You'll want to host, make, teach, and buy craft supplies you'll use twice.
open.end: Yeon: But there's a catch to a year this pleasant, and you'll hit it by spring. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Flower. The first invitation of the year | arrives, and how you answer it sets the tone for months.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: one thing just for joy, every week. Non-negotiable. Put it in the calendar like a meeting.

base.the-year:
Fire meeting fire. More friends, more collabs, more people who want what you want.

Bom: The Goat underneath gives you a creative push. Ideas, projects, things that show your talent.

Yeon: It also gives you a sharper tongue. Not every hot take needs posting.

Bom: Team up with the rival instead of beating them. Two suns can light a stadium.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the sun, it's a year with another sun in the sky.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Another sun. So someone's going to compete with you for attention. Good luck to them.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Big energy, big ideas. Share the spotlight and it gets bigger.

spring.intro: The sun, born in spring. Everything was feeding you: new leaves, longer days, people who wanted your attention. So you grew up assuming warmth is normal. When someone's cold to you, it genuinely confuses you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooms get brighter when you arrive. That is not nothing.

summer.intro: The sun at noon in July. Double fire. You don't enter rooms, you arrive. Generous, loud, impossible to ignore, and secretly a little hurt every time someone doesn't notice you lit the place up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Main character, sequel, director's cut. All you.

earth.intro: Born in the between-season weeks, when Earth runs things. For the sun, that means everything you give turns into something solid: a friend's confidence, a plan that worked, a party you made happen. You're a great investment. Ask what you're getting back.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You fund everyone's glow-up and forget to invoice.

autumn.intro: An autumn sun. Lower in the sky, aimed at things: harvest, goals, results. You're warm, but you're also counting. You notice exactly who showed up for you and who just liked the post.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Warm and keeping score. Your sunshine comes with receipts.

winter.intro: A winter sun. Short days, cold air, people who needed you more than they could give back. It made you tough and a little performative: the brightest one in the room, even on the days you're running on fumes.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You shine hardest when you're the most tired. I see it.

open.title: 2027: someone tries to outshine you. It doesn't go how they planned.
open.text:
The year's fire matches yours. Saju calls it Rob Wealth: a peer, a rival, someone who wants the same room. Your social life gets louder and so does the competition.

Bom: You'll find your people this year.

Yeon: You'll find your people and immediately start a friendly rivalry with one of them.
open.end: Yeon: How you handle the second sun decides how good this year gets. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Sun. Someone new walks in with your exact | energy, and your first instinct about them is going to be wrong.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: one collab you'd normally treat as competition. Say yes to it.

base.the-year:
Fire meeting fire, same flavour. Your circle grows and feels like home.

Bom: The Goat underneath brings the Eating God: making things you love, just because.

Yeon: Which means you might finally finish the creative thing. The one with nine drafts.

Bom: Let the year be warm. You're allowed a year that's mostly good.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the candle, the year shares your flame.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Shares your flame. So suddenly you have friends. You'll need to reply to messages. Brave.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: A warm year. People, creativity, and making things for the love of it.

spring.intro: A candle lit in spring. Fed from every side, so your warmth is steady and close: one person, one conversation, the whole night. You'd take a deep two-hour talk over a party of fifty every single time.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: When you pay attention to someone, they feel chosen.

summer.intro: A candle in midsummer. Double fire, so the flame runs hot: intense focus, intense loyalty, intense feelings you insist are "fine". You don't do half anything. That includes holding a grudge.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You remember a tone of voice from 2019. Word for word.

earth.intro: Born in the soil weeks between seasons. Your candle burns into the ground: caring, fixing, holding people together. You make every space feel like home. You also over-give until the wax runs out.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You hosted everyone's crisis. Who's hosting yours?

autumn.intro: A candle in autumn, burning toward a goal. You're quietly ambitious, a little perfectionist, and you light up most when you're useful. The danger is that you start to believe useful is the only way to be loved.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to earn the warmth you give everyone else.

winter.intro: A candle in winter. Cold all around, so your small flame matters more. You grew up being the warm one in a chilly place, which made you protective, careful, and very good at sensing a mood change from the next room.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You can hear a sigh through a closed door. Through two.

open.title: 2027: you get a crowd. You'll have to reply to the group chat.
open.text:
The year's fire is the same as yours, candle to candle. Saju calls it the Friend. More people who get you. More warmth around you than you're used to.

Bom: You'll feel less alone this year.

Yeon: You'll feel less alone and slightly overwhelmed by brunch invitations.
open.end: Yeon: More warmth sounds lovely. It comes with one thing you'll have to learn. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Candle. The year wakes up warm, and the first | person you let closer is not the one you'd have bet on.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: finish one creative thing. Imperfect. Released. Done.

base.the-year:
Fire feeding Earth. Teachers, backers and good advice show up for you.

Bom: You don't have to carry everything alone this year.

Yeon: The Goat underneath brings Rob Wealth: a peer, a sibling, a friend competing for the same prize.

Bom: Take the help. Share the prize if you need to. Mountains grow taller with support.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the mountain, it's a warm, supported year.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Supported. Meaning people will try to help you. You'll hate it. Let them.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The fire warms you from inside. Learning, backing, people opening doors.

spring.intro: A mountain in spring, with trees pushing through it from every side. Life tested you early. That's why you're so steady now, and also why "relax" sounds to you like a trick.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You became the calm one because someone had to.

summer.intro: A summer mountain, warmed all the way through. Solid, generous, the one everyone leans on. You give off safety without trying. People tell you things they've never told anyone, and you never repeat them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: People feel safe with you within five minutes. Rare.

earth.intro: A mountain born in Earth's own weeks. Triple solid. You don't move unless you want to, and you almost never want to. Your loyalty is legendary. So is the time it takes you to change your mind.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Persuading you is a geological process.

autumn.intro: An autumn mountain, showing its stone. You turn your weight into output: work done, things built, problems quietly solved. You don't talk about feelings much. You show them by fixing the shelf.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Love language: unasked-for repairs. Every time.

winter.intro: A mountain in winter, holding back the river. You manage things: money, plans, other people's chaos. Very good at it. The cost is that you rarely let anything thaw, including you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're not cold. You're frozen on purpose. Different.

open.title: 2027: people try to help you. You hate it. Let them anyway.
open.text:
The year's fire feeds your Earth. Saju calls it the Direct Resource: mentors, support, learning, the feeling of being backed.

Bom: You'll feel warmer than you have in a while.

Yeon: You'll feel warmer and suspicious of every kind offer. Relax. Not everything has a catch.
open.end: Yeon: But someone close wants the same thing you want this year. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Mountain. An offer of help lands, and your | first instinct is to say "I'm fine". Don't.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: accept three offers of help. Count them. Yes, actually count.

base.the-year:
Fire warming Earth. Odd courses, new hobbies, the weird podcast that rearranges your thinking.

Bom: The Goat underneath is Earth like you. Saju calls it the Friend.

Yeon: More friends, more people at your table, more people asking you for things.

Bom: Choose your circle on purpose. Warmth is better shared with the right few.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the garden field, it's a year of learning and close friends.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Close friends. So the group chat gets louder and you'll be the admin. Again.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Warm fire feeds you, and your own kind of people gather round.

spring.intro: A garden in spring, with everything sprouting from you at once. You grew up being needed: the friend who listens, the kid who helped. Lovely trait. Exhausting default.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You nourish everybody. Your turn next.

summer.intro: Garden soil in summer, warm and rich. You're nurturing on instinct and practical about it: snacks in the bag, charger for everyone, a plan B nobody asked for. Everyone feels a bit safer near you.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You packed plasters for a picnic. Twice.

earth.intro: Soil born in soil weeks. Double Earth. You're the steady one, the reliable one, the one who remembers birthdays. You can also absorb other people's moods like a sponge and call it "being supportive".

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Their mood, your weekend. Every time.

autumn.intro: A harvest-season garden. Everything you grow, you hand out. Ideas, help, advice, food. The harvest is real, but so is the empty field afterwards, and you never schedule time to grow back.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Giving is your gift. Refilling is your homework.

winter.intro: A winter garden. Frozen on top, busy underneath. You worry productively: lists, backups, a mental spreadsheet of who needs what. You keep it together for everyone, and you'd never admit you're scared too.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You overthink in organised folders. Colour-coded.

open.title: 2027: you learn something weird and it changes everything.
open.text:
The year's fire feeds your soil in an unusual way. Saju calls it the Indirect Resource: unconventional learning, side interests, a mentor you didn't plan on.

Bom: You'll grow in a direction nobody expected.

Yeon: You'll grow in a direction nobody expected and explain it badly at Christmas.
open.end: Yeon: And the Goat brings your people closer. Not all of them should be. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Field. Someone asks you to take on one | more thing, and the answer you give decides how tired you'll be by June.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: learn one thing nobody expects. Drop one obligation nobody will miss.

base.the-year:
Fire forging metal. A promotion, a title, a commitment that asks you to step up.

Bom: The Goat underneath brings the Direct Resource: support, teachers, backup.

Yeon: Which you will ignore, because asking for help feels like losing. It isn't.

Bom: Lead well this year. Let people hold the other end.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the sword, it's a forging year.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Forging. So you get put in the fire. On purpose. For your own good. Thanks, 2027.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Fire shapes metal. This year, responsibility shapes you into something better.

spring.intro: A blade born in spring, surrounded by things to cut. You see what needs doing and you do it, preferably before anyone has finished explaining. Efficient. Also sometimes the reason the meeting went badly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You solved their problem. They wanted a hug. Classic.

summer.intro: A sword forged in summer. Heat everywhere, so you were shaped by pressure: deadlines, expectations, people who pushed. It made you strong and principled. It also made you assume love is a test you can fail.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You don't have to pass anything. You're already loved.

earth.intro: A sword still in the stone. Born in the soil weeks, so you were held, fed and protected before you were ever swung. That gives you patience most Swords lack, and a stubborn streak made of actual rock.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Patient, until you're not. Then it's a sword.

autumn.intro: A sword born in autumn, metal's own season. Double steel. Loyal to the bone, blunt as a brick, and fair in a way that scares people. You'd fight anyone for a friend, and tell that friend exactly where they went wrong on the way home.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You'd take a bullet for a friend. Then critique their aim.

winter.intro: A blade in winter. Cold, clear, and sharpened by thinking. You say less than other Swords, but when you speak it lands like a verdict. People quote you back to yourself years later.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your words stay with people. Choose the kind ones too.

open.title: 2027: you get handed the responsibility. You were born for it.
open.text:
The year's fire is the kind that shapes a sword. Saju calls it the Direct Officer: structure, responsibility, a role with your name on it.

Bom: You'll be trusted with something important.

Yeon: You'll be trusted with something important and act like it's no big deal. It's a big deal.
open.end: Yeon: The good news: you don't have to carry it alone. The bad news: you'll try to. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Sword. Someone puts you in charge of | something you didn't ask for, and how you react in the first week matters more than the job.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: take the responsibility, ask for one kind of help. Both. Same month.

base.the-year:
Fire pressing on fine metal. Deadlines, expectations, someone who pushes your buttons.

Bom: The Goat underneath brings the Indirect Resource: unexpected support, a mentor, a new way of thinking.

Yeon: You'll learn faster than you have in years. Mostly because you have no choice.

Bom: Don't polish everything this year. Polish what matters.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the jewel, it's a year of pressure and polish.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Pressure and polish. So, your normal personality, but with a deadline.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: Fire tests the jewel. What comes out is brighter.

spring.intro: A jewel born in spring. Everything was growing and you noticed all of it: what's pretty, what's off, what's three millimetres crooked. You have taste. You also have opinions about other people's taste.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You judged the font on their birthday card. Silently.

summer.intro: A jewel in summer heat. Pressure shaped you: to look good, do well, never be the embarrassing one. You're polished and impressive. One careless comment can still ruin your whole week.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You're allowed to be unfinished. It's charming, honestly.

earth.intro: A jewel still in the earth. Born in the soil weeks, so you were protected, maybe a little over-protected. You need to feel safe before you sparkle, and that's not a flaw. It's quality control.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You need three green flags before one selfie.

autumn.intro: A jewel born in metal's own season. Double shine. High standards, sharp eye, zero patience for sloppy. You're the friend people dress up for. You're also the friend people are slightly scared to disappoint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You're a five-star review. With a long comment section.

winter.intro: A jewel in winter water, washed clear. Your mind is quick and your words are precise. You can say one sentence that fixes everything, or one that ends everything. Most of the time you know which.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You see people so clearly. Use it to be kind.

open.title: 2027: under pressure. You'll come out shinier. Annoyingly.
open.text:
The year's fire presses on your metal. Saju calls it the Seven Killings, which is a terrible name for something that mostly means challenge and growth.

Bom: You'll be tested. And you'll rise.

Yeon: You'll be tested, rise, then complain about the lighting at your own success.
open.end: Yeon: The pressure has a source this year, and you'll recognise it by March. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Jewel. A challenge shows up that looks | unfair. It's actually the thing that makes your whole year.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: one big thing done really well. Everything else "good enough". Yes, really.

base.the-year:
Fire bound to water. A person, a project, an opportunity that keeps pulling you back.

Bom: The Goat underneath brings the Direct Officer: structure, responsibility, a respectable role.

Yeon: Banks on the river. You'll fight it, then realise it's the best thing that happened to you.

Bom: Let 2027 be the year you choose something and stay.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the ocean, it's a year with a famous pull.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: A famous pull. Translation: something or someone gets you to commit. The ocean. Committing. Wild.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: The year's fire and your water make a natural bond. Something worth staying for.

spring.intro: The ocean in spring, pouring itself into everything that grows. You're full of ideas and you give them away: plans, pep talks, 3am theories. People feel bigger around you. You sometimes feel emptier after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You make people feel possible. Keep a little for you.

summer.intro: The ocean in summer, chasing everything. Big appetite for life: trips, people, projects, the next thing. You're magnetic and hard to pin down. Being pinned down is honestly your nightmare.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You said "let's see where it goes". You meant "don't make me commit".

earth.intro: An ocean held by cliffs. Born in the soil weeks, so you grew up with banks and rules around you. It gave you focus. It also left you with a quiet itch to flood something just to prove you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You follow every rule. Until one random Tuesday.

autumn.intro: The ocean in autumn, fed by every stream. Deep, informed, a little too clever. You absorb everything and you can talk your way out of anything. That includes your own feelings.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You intellectualise heartbreak. With footnotes.

winter.intro: The ocean in winter. Double water. Deep, cold on top, enormous underneath. You need a lot of freedom and you think in huge loops. People call you mysterious. You just haven't decided yet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your depth scares shallow people. That's their problem.

open.title: 2027: something gets you to commit. Yes, you.
open.text:
The year's fire is your Direct Wealth, and in saju 丁 and 壬 form one of the five classic pairings: they naturally bind.

Bom: Attraction, partnership, things worth building.

Yeon: Something actually holds your attention for more than three weeks. Historic.
open.end: Yeon: What exactly pulls you in is on the next page. You'll recognise it.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Ocean. The pull starts small: one message, | one meeting, one idea you can't shake. Pay attention to which one.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: commit to one thing for twelve months. Then decide. Not after week three.

base.the-year:
Fire you control, same polarity. New connections, new projects, a fuller calendar.

Bom: The Goat underneath brings the Seven Killings: a challenge that asks for courage.

Yeon: Something scary and good. Like a karaoke night. But for your career.

Bom: Say yes more than you usually would. Leave early if you need to. But go.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: 2027 is the Fire Goat. For the rain, it's a lively, social year.

base_panels.speaker: yeon
base_panels.text: Social. So you'll get invited places. You'll want to cancel. You'll go anyway. Growth.

base_panels.speaker: bom
base_panels.text: More people, more chances, more surprises. The year draws you out.

spring.intro: Spring rain. You feed everything around you without anyone noticing it was you. You sense moods, fix vibes, water other people's plants. Quietly essential. Quietly forgotten. Not anymore.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Everything grows a little when you're around.

summer.intro: Rain in summer, gone the moment it lands. You chase what you want in quiet, clever ways, and you vanish when a room gets too loud. People find you fascinating. They also never quite know where you went.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You left the party without saying bye. Again. Iconic.

earth.intro: Rain falling on hard ground. Born in the soil weeks, so you met walls early: rules, expectations, people who didn't get you. You learned to soak in slowly instead of crashing through. Patient. Persistent. Underrated.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: You don't fight walls. You just wear them down. Over years.

autumn.intro: Autumn rain, fed by cool clean air. Intuitive to the point of spooky. You know who's lying, who's sad, and who's about to text before your phone even lights up.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your gut is right more often than your decisions are.

winter.intro: Winter rain. Double water. Still, deep, mostly internal. You feel everything at full volume and show about four percent of it. Your notes app has more emotional range than most novels.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your quiet isn't empty. It's full.

open.title: 2027: you get invited out. A lot. You'll survive.
open.text:
The year's fire is your Indirect Wealth: opportunity, adventure, things you chase. 丁 and 癸 also face off in saju, so expect a few surprises.

Bom: Life gets fuller.

Yeon: Life gets fuller and your "sorry, can't make it" texts get worse at hiding.
open.end: Yeon: There's one challenge in the mix that'll make you braver than you'd choose. Next page.

cliff.text: Yeon: February, Rain. The first invitation you want to | decline is the one you should accept. Trust me on this one.

sample.text: Your plan for 2027: say yes to one scary thing a month. Twelve brave things. That's the year.
